vectors.name: synthesized_defaults_v0
vectors.why: Every field this version declares, at its protocol default. Synthesized so the message is held to Apache Kafka's bytes at all; hand-written cases carry the interesting shapes.

vectors.name: a_legacy_data_schema_with_arrays_and_nullable_bytes
vectors.why: This schema declares flexibleVersions none, so its arrays carry int32 length prefixes and its nullable bytes carry int32 -1 — the legacy side of every choice the emitter makes. Kafka's own bytes are the only thing that proves this repository did not quietly treat a data schema as flexible.

vectors.name: synthesized_populated_v0
vectors.why: Every field this version declares, present and non-default: one element in every array, every nullable thing supplied. The defaults case leaves arrays empty, which hides every field of the struct the array would have held — a records field encoded with the wrong length prefix survived the whole corpus that way, because nothing ever reached the struct holding it.
